text:
deploy-bot: Requested staged rollout v3.6.0 -> 3% (eu-west-2). Initiated by @katie. change_window: 01:00-03:00 UTC. Preflight running.

deploy-bot: Preflight snapshot:
``nchecks: [compat, kv-cache, eval-smoke]
baseline: ok
embed-delta: +1.25% on 'billing-embed-seed' (small weighted set)
startup-p95: +22ms transient
``n
katie: seeing the embed delta. set is small but relevant to billing flows. devin: how noisy is the signal?
pm-ryan: window is 18m on the eval harness. approx 0.4% of traffic touches that set. drift threshold is 1.0% for billing. this crosses it.
sre-marta: infra shows a short p95 bump during canary warmup, likely cache priming. no 5xx.
devin: i propose we let 3% warm but lock any automated ramp. if drift stays >1% after 10m we pin back and rollback.
katie: agree. prepare rollback & pin command. also draft short release-note text in case.
infra-bot: action: pre-warm kv cache on canary nodes and watch p95. started.
deploy-bot: shifting traffic -> 3%...
```
action: shift_traffic(v3.6.0, 0.03)
status: in_progress
```

pm-ryan: tagging 'billing-embed-seed' for continuous eval. request diffs at +5m and +12m.
sre-marta: pre-warm finished, restarting canary pods gracefully to pick up warm cache. will report in ~6m.
devin: ML team run quick A/B against v3.5.8 for that prompt subset and share top examples.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift complete: 3% -> v3.6.0. canaries report ready.

pm-ryan: +5m eval: embed delta ~+1.18% (slightly down), global metrics unchanged.
sre-marta: p95 stabilized after pre-warm, but saw two short CPU pressure spikes on one canary node during warmup window. correlated with image pulls.
katie: vote?
devin: vote=hold. do NOT progress to 10%. :no_entry_sign:
pm-ryan: vote recorded: HOLD. scheduling a quick sync in 12m.
devin: prepared rollback/pin: `deploy rollback --to v3.5.8 --region eu-west-2 && pin-version v3.5.8 --reason "canary embed delta"`
katie: release-note blurb ready (one-liner): "Paused v3.6.0 rollout at 3% in eu-west-2 due to a detected embedding delta on billing flows; investigating."
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 3% by operator hold. automated rollback disabled for this rollout.
sre-marta: action items: (1) infra confirm image-pull mitigation, (2) ML provide A/B diff + top 5 examples, (3) Product prepare stakeholder note and rollback blurb if needed. reconvene in 12m.
pm-ryan: marking change window as PAUSED in tracker and notifying stakeholders. :rotating_light:
